name: gemini-subagent
description: Managed official Antigravity and optional Gemini CLI workers for macOS and native Windows.

interface.shortDescription: Run controlled Google CLI workers from Codex
interface.longDescription: Delegate work to official Antigravity or optional Gemini CLI workers with managed lifecycle and durable results. One lean plugin shares five skills across macOS and Windows 11 23H2+ x64. Windows evidence covers ordinary-user single-account agy CLI tasks; review version-bound validation for exact results. Named agy profiles use OS credential storage and a pinned provider contract. Windows shared reads and desktop App integration remain unavailable.
defaultPrompt: Show Gemini worker, quota, account, or session status with $gemini-subagent:status
Retrieve the latest managed Gemini result with $gemini-subagent:result
